name: coat
description: A long coat with two sleeves, an open neckline and a flared lower hem.
useCase: Identify coats or longer outerwear in a clothing catalogue.
misuse: Use a visible label when clothing identifies a product, size or dress requirement.

16.reason: The long flared body stays open on both sides of the center fastening.

24.reason: The larger coat keeps two full sleeves above its wide lower hem.
